scorer_data_state_at_freeze: PRISTINE -- no Phase 0 episode has been collected

block.verdict: CLEAN under the corrected four checks: declared 0, broad 0, spans 0, history 0, positive control valid (17 commits)

rejected_predecessors.9500001..9500256: seed 9500029 is a DECLARED evaluation seed in C1_CONFIRMATION.json::evaluation_seeds (history 132b6680). Using a spent evaluation seed as scorer TRAINING data is evaluation leakage.
rejected_predecessors.9700001..9700256: overlaps 'c1_crossover': [9700000, 9700029]. Exposed an audit blind spot: endpoint-expressed ranges were not expanded, so 30 used seeds appeared as 2 literals. Tool fixed before this block was accepted.

GATE_0A_allocation.pairing: paired by seed across all four cells, so the crossover comparison is paired rather than independent
GATE_0A_allocation.if_fails: STOP. Do not fit a critic on a dataset where the target structure is absent.

scorer_split.why_not_by_state: states within an episode are correlated; a state-level split would leak the episode outcome into both sides
scorer_split.why_96_not_64: Gate 0B is a go/no-go prerequisite for an entire new 2M-step method. A thin held-out set cannot carry an LCB. 96 seeds x 3 branches = 288 matched states per pole.

counterfactual_source_rule.rule: ONE source trajectory per pole per seed
counterfactual_source_rule.source_policy_balance: 128 seeds use pi_A's trajectory as the source state distribution, 128 use pi_B's, PER POLE
counterfactual_source_rule.assignment: fixed BEFORE collection, deterministic from seed parity or a frozen balanced assignment
counterfactual_source_rule.at_each_selected_state: BOTH teachers are queried and branched from the identical state
counterfactual_source_rule.note: this is why the counterfactual set costs 512 sources rather than all 1024 cell trajectories

branches.selection: one decision point from each of the early / middle / late tertiles of the episode horizon
branches.why_stratified_not_uniform: uniform sampling concentrates on cheap early states (expected prefix ~ half the episode) and could under-cover late strategic commitments, teaching the scorer early-game navigation instead of decisive moments
branches.fallback_if_a_tertile_has_no_decision_po: choose the nearest eligible decision point outside that tertile, without duplicating an already selected point
branches.fallback_if_fewer_than_three_unique_elig: use all available points and RECORD the shortfall
branches.continuation: TEACHER-CONSISTENT -- branch A continues under pi_A, branch B under pi_B (from the parent protocol)

per_pole_contrasts.d_A(o): V_hat(o, pi_A, A) - V_hat(o, pi_B, A)
per_pole_contrasts.d_B(o): V_hat(o, pi_B, B) - V_hat(o, pi_A, B)

GATE_0B_inferential_not_descriptive.why: the three branch states within an episode are correlated. For each bootstrap draw, resample the 96 held-out seeds and retain ALL branch points belonging to each selected seed.
GATE_0B_inferential_not_descriptive.calibration: must hold per policy/pole cell, not merely in aggregate

cost.measured_basis: episode length mean 235.5, median 240 (horizon cap), ~193 decision points per episode, from the 768 EXP1 evaluation rows
cost.comparison: ~30% above the rejected 2-branch plan; accepted deliberately because Phase 0 decides whether another 2M-step run is justified at all

DATA_GROWTH_AFTER_FAILURE.rule: if either gate fails on this frozen allocation, SPPPO stops. The scorer dataset is not enlarged until it passes.
DATA_GROWTH_AFTER_FAILURE.reason: a feasibility gate that can be grown after failure is not a gate

audit_tool_lesson_for_provenance_notes: a positive control proves the scanner detects a KNOWN hit; it does not prove that every syntactic form of expressing a seed range is expanded. Interval expression is a distinct class of coverage failure. The control fired correctly through all four defects found in this tool (.jsonl/.log omission, decimal false positives, under-matching history query, endpoint-range non-expansion) and caught none of them; redundant checks found each.
